name: maxio-sdk-lean
description: Install and consume the Maxio Advanced Billing .NET SDK, grounded in an SDK map that ships inside the SDK's own source. A single maxio-sdk agent clones the SDK once, reads the map from the root of that clone, and opens a named source file from the same clone where the map leaves a fact ambiguous. The map is lean: each operation row states what is specific to that operation, the SDK-wide defaults are stated once in the index, and the HTTP route and endpoint prose sit on the operation in Api/{Controller}.cs. The agent plans a map-grounded contract sheet, answers narrow contract questions, and fixes SDK compile/build errors in place. Includes the integrate-maxio router and the map-grounded maxio-sdk agent. No MCP server.
